**Summary:**

I successfully resolved ticket T-3008. The clickhouse-2 pod was stuck in ContainerCreating due to the storage array (cv-array-02) reaching its maximum LUN mapping limit (512 mappings per host group). The PersistentVolumeClaim and node assignment were correct, but the CSI driver could not attach the volume. I provided the ticket owner with clear instructions to contact the storage team for mapping cleanup on the array, after which Kubernetes will automatically retry and the pod should start successfully.
